description: This Kotlin source file defines the BackupListAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter used for displaying a list of backup filenames in an Android application. It includes logic for binding backup data to UI elements and handling user interactions like restore and delete actions.

classes.name: BackupListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter managing a list of backup filenames, providing view binding, diffing, and click handling for restore and delete actions.
